summary: Add an unattended reconciler that builds, signs and installs a tracked Git ref as the daily iOS Release when a host scheduler invokes it.

compatibility.detail: No daemon, client or wire change; the app and its Debug variant are unchanged.

manual.detail: The script starts nothing on its own. Enabling the host scheduler that invokes it is a separate change, held until the maintainer approves it.

recovery.detail: No recovery change; delivery state stays in its private state directory.
